title: Bounded weighted sum
statement: Implement bounded_weighted_sum. For each value at zero-based index i, clamp the value to the inclusive range [-cap, cap], multiply it by i + 1, and return the sum. The empty list returns 0.
constraints: all inputs and intermediate results fit in signed 64-bit integers
